Resume this FreeHighlander repository without relying on previous chat history.

1. Read AGENTS.md.
2. Read .freehighlander/state.yaml.
3. Read PROJECT_STATE.md.
4. Read docs/state/RESUME-PROTOCOL.md and docs/state/TRIPLE-MODE.md.
5. Verify local branch/worktree and remote Git/GitHub pointers.
6. Load the smallest context profile required by .freehighlander/context.yaml.
7. State:
   - current phase,
   - active work item / PR,
   - current blocker,
   - logical role/stage,
   - exact next safe action.
8. Continue only if repository and remote state agree.

Do not fabricate missing model-review evidence.
